name: code-review
author: Marchand
description: Review your uncommitted changes like a senior engineer.

commands.name: review
commands.prompt: Review my uncommitted changes. Run `git diff` (and `git diff --staged`), read the changed files for context, then report: bugs, missing edge cases, security problems, style mismatches, missing tests. Order by severity, cite file:line, and propose a concrete fix for each. Do not edit files. {args}

commands.name: review-file
commands.prompt: Review the file {args} in depth: correctness, edge cases, readability, performance, tests. Do not edit files; give a ranked list with line numbers and fixes.
